import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[6];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        Arrays.sort(a, 0, n);
        n = n / 2;
        System.out.println(a[n]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
